mapper.select:
select stf.staff_sign as staffSign, stf.phone, stf.enable_flag as enableFlag, stf.primary_key as staffCode, stfr.primary_key as primaryKey, stfr.unity_no AS unityNo, coalesce(stfr.sex,r.sex) AS sex, stfr.age AS age, coalesce(stfr.id_card,r.id_number) AS idCard, d.department_sign AS departmentSign, p.post_sign AS postSign, stfr.contract_date AS contractDate, stfr.contract_allotted AS contractAllotted, stfr.address AS address, stfr.birth_date AS birthDate, stfr.remark AS remark, stfr.technical_level AS technicalLevel, stfr.degree AS degree, stfr.major AS major, stfr.speciality AS speciality, stfr.photo AS photo, stfr.graduate_school AS graduateSchool, r.education from ${staffTableName} stf left join ${staffRecordTableName} stfr on stf.primary_key = stfr.staff_code left join ${departmentTableName} d on stf.department = d.primary_key left join ${postTableName} p on stf.post = p.primary_key left join (WITH RankedResumes AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY phone ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn FROM ${resumeTableName} WHERE delete_flag = false AND is_employed = true ) SELECT * FROM RankedResumes WHERE rn = 1) r on stf.phone = r.phone where stf.delete_flag = false and stf.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and stf.type in (1,3,5,7)
and stf.staff_sign like '%'|| #{requestData.staffSign} ||'%'
and stfr.unity_no like '%'|| #{requestData.unityNo} ||'%'
and stf.phone like '%'|| #{requestData.phone} ||'%'
and (stfr.sex = #{requestData.sex} or r.sex = #{requestData.sex})
and stfr.contract_date is not null and stfr.contract_allotted is not null AND ( EXTRACT(YEAR FROM stfr.contract_date) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{requestData.startYear} AS DATE)))
AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM stfr.contract_date + CASE WHEN stfr.contract_allotted IS NULL THEN '0 years'::interval ELSE (stfr.contract_allotted || ' years')::interval END) <= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{requestData.endYear} AS DATE)))
AND stf.primary_key IN
#{code}
order by stf.id desc
LIMIT #{requestData.pageSize} OFFSET #{requestData.offset}

update.foreach: UPDATE ${staffRecordTableName} SET technical_level = #{item.technicalLevel}, sex = #{item.sex}, degree = #{item.degree}, major = #{item.major}, age = #{item.age}, speciality = #{item.speciality}, contract_allotted = #{item.contractAllotted}, address = #{item.address}, unity_no = #{item.unityNo}, remark = #{item.remark}, birth_date = #{item.birthDate}, contract_date = #{item.contractDate}, photo = #{item.photo}, graduate_school = #{item.graduateSchool}, id_card = #{item.idCard}, update_time = now() WHERE primary_key = #{item.primaryKey}
